title: limonium coralloides
intro: Limonium coralloides, commonly known as Coral Sea Lavender or Coral Sea Statice, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Plumbaginaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Limonium coralloides include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities, which can contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
